notes: Sources: LSEG Annual Reports 2019 and 2025 from _ingest/raw/lseg/articles.jsonl (type 'Annual Report'; filtered text = strategic report + principal risks). Not on EDGAR; nothing downloaded. total_revenue is TOTAL INCOME (revenue + Net Treasury Income + other income): FY2019 £2,314m (continuing); FY2025 £8,986m excluding recoveries (£9,346m incl. £360m recoveries). FY2019 is on the OLD, pre-Refinitiv basis (Information Services, LCH, CC&G/Monte Titoli, Capital Markets, Technology Services); Refinitiv closed Jan 2021 and Borsa Italiana (incl. CC&G, Monte Titoli, MTS) was sold to Euronext in Apr 2021, so most lines have no counterpart. Lines are nulled where no comparable figure exists; bridging lines carry basis_note. FY2025 tables restate 2024 for 2025 reallocations between business lines (product-led model). LSEG's FY2025 Markets lines are: Equities 412, FIDO 1,539, FX 272, OTC Derivatives 641, Securities & Reporting 229, Non-Cash Collateral 117 (= revenue 3,210) + NTI 257. Risk headings are LSEG's 'risk category' names (13 principal risks in Strategic / Financial & Model / Non-Financial groups) plus 1 emerging risk (Disruptive technology, order 14). There is no standalone competition risk; competition appears inside Disruptive technology and Reputation/Brand/IP.
